snippet.title: Farm Builder - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Farm Builder is strategy puzzle board game in which you have to construct farms, roads and surround windmills and water-towers in order to score points.

The game is online multiplayer and in each room can play between 2 and 5 people together.

The winner is the player who manages to score the most points.

To make points you have to own a completed farm, road, windmill or water tower. This is done by placing farmers and tractors (pieces) which indicate that you own the property.

Developed by LAN - GAMES EOOD
Also released for Xbox One, Nintendo Switch and PC

#ps4 #playstation4 #farmbuilder #theforeseenarcade
